WITH group_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    o.account_id,
    d.A3 as region,
    AVG(o.amount) as group_avg
  FROM `order` o
  INNER JOIN account a ON o.account_id = a.account_id
  INNER JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
  WHERE o.amount >= 2802
  GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(group_avg) as overall_average
  FROM group_averages
)
SELECT 
  ga.account_id,
  ga.region,
  ga.group_avg,
  ga.group_avg - oa.overall_average as difference
FROM group_averages ga
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10;
